items.title: Schedule drying appointment with Trocknungstechnik Beispiel
items.quote:
Bitte vereinbaren Sie binnen 5 Arbeitstagen ab Briefdatum einen Termin mit der Firma
Trocknungstechnik Beispiel (Telefon 0541 22 11 00); Arbeitstage sind Montag bis Freitag,
gesetzliche Feiertage ausgenommen.
items.computation: Letter is dated Wednesday 20.05.2026. The period runs 'ab Briefdatum' (from the letter date), so per §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (20.05.2026) is not counted; counting starts the next day, Thursday 21.05.2026. Business days (Mon-Fri, excluding statutory holidays) are counted: Day 1 = Thu 21.05.2026; Day 2 = Fri 22.05.2026; weekend Sat 23.05./Sun 24.05.2026 not counted; Mon 25.05.2026 is Pfingstmontag (Whit Monday), a statutory holiday in NRW (Easter Sunday 2026 = 05.04.2026, so Pentecost = 24.05.2026, Whit Monday = 25.05.2026) and therefore not counted as a business day; Day 3 = Tue 26.05.2026; Day 4 = Wed 27.05.2026; Day 5 = Thu 28.05.2026. The 5th business day, Thursday 28.05.2026, is the deadline by which the appointment must be arranged (not itself a holiday or weekend day, so no further shift under §193 BGB is needed).
